### workspace resize --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace resize [project] <pane-spec>

Resize tmux panes for a running workspace project.

Pane spec is a comma-separated list of sizes, one per pane:
  Rows:       10 or 10h     (absolute row count)
  Percentage: 50%           (percentage of window height)
  Skip:       (empty)       (leave pane as-is)

Examples:
  workspace resize myproject 15%,,35%      # pane 0=15%, skip 1, pane 2=35%
  workspace resize myproject 10h,80%,20%   # pane 0=10 rows, 1=80%, 2=20%
  workspace resize myproject 33%,33%,33%   # equal thirds
--- stderr
--- end
